Class LinkTileEvent

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.net.events.clientevents.ClientEvent
it.polimi.ingsw.net.events.clientevents.buildingevents.LinkTileEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class LinkTileEvent extends ClientEvent
Represents an event where a client wants to link a specific component to a given position on the spaceship
